fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Revenue (broad definition). Marketing Fee is 1.5% of Gross Rooms Revenue plus 1.5% of Gross Rental Revenue for Dwellings; may increase up to 3% each. Tech fees include CRS (per-transaction, varies by channel), CRM ($12.50/room/month plus other fees), Loyalty Program $10/room/month, Property Website Hosting $875-$1,400/month, Medallia $7,500/year, National Sales Org $1,100/month, Flip.to $150/month. Dwelling Royalty 3% of Gross Dwelling Revenue; Rental Royalty 5% of Gross Rental Revenue (if Dwellings approved).
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee 5% of Gross Revenue; Marketing Fee Currently, 1.5% of Gross Rooms Revenue, plus 1.5% of Gross Rental Revenue for any Dwellings
